mapper.sql: select crpb_llave as llaveTabla ,crpb_plantilla as plantilla ,(select cdpl_nombre from documentoplantilla_dplp where cdpl_llave = crpb_plantilla) as plantillaNombre ,crpb_nombre as nombre ,crpb_codigo as codigo ,brpb_soloexistente as soloExistente ,crpb_variables as variables ,nrpb_version as version ,crpb_descripcion as descripcion ,crpb_servidor as servidor ,(select cser_urlconexion from servidor_serp where cser_llave = crpb_servidor) as servidorUrl ,brpb_publico as publico ,crpb_estado as estado from reportebase_rpbp a
mapper.select: update reportebase_rpbp set crpb_plantilla = #{plantilla}, crpb_nombre = #{nombre}, crpb_codigo = #{codigo}, brpb_soloexistente = #{soloExistente}, crpb_variables = #{variables}, nrpb_version = #{version}, crpb_descripcion = #{descripcion}, crpb_servidor = #{servidor}, brpb_publico = #{publico}, crpb_estado =#{estado}

select crpb_llave as llaveTabla ,crpb_nombre as nombre ,crpb_codigo as codigo ,null as jasperText ,crpb_variables as variables ,crpb_plantilla as plantilla ,brpb_soloexistente as soloExistente ,crpb_servidor as servidor ,(select cser_urlconexion from servidor_serp where cser_llave = crpb_servidor) as servidorUrl ,crpb_estado as estado from reportebase_rpbp a where crpb_estado ='A' and crpb_llave not in (select cppd_valor from propiedad_ppdp where cppd_estado = 'A' and cppd_propiedadvalor in ('PROP_72','PROP_70','PROP_100','PROP_137'))
